latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the amazon-buy-box skill:

- Analyze Buy Box eligibility and competitor pricing to help maximize Buy Box percentage.
- Supports multiple platforms, including Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, TikTok Shop, Etsy, eBay, and BigCommerce.
- Provides actionable recommendations on FBA vs FBM, account health, and repricing strategy.
- Output includes summary, benchmarks, prioritized actions, and next steps.
- Collects user info, follows up with all questions at once (multi-choice), and delivers structured, specific advice.
